sentences.text: A cat sits on your legs.
It starts to make a low sound.
You can feel it in your hands.
Everybody knows what this means.
The cat is happy.
That is true, but it is not all.
Cats also purr when they are hurt.
sentences.translationRu: Кошки мурлычут и когда им больно.

sentences.text: They purr at the doctor.
They purr when they are giving birth.
Some cats purr when they are dying.
So it is not only happiness.
sentences.translationRu: Значит, дело не только в радости.

sentences.text: First, how do they do it?
For a long time nobody knew.
A cat has no special organ for it.
sentences.translationRu: Отдельного органа у кошки для этого нет.

sentences.text: The sound comes from the throat.
Small muscles open and close very fast.
sentences.translationRu: Маленькие мышцы очень быстро открываются и закрываются.

sentences.text: About thirty times a second.
Air passes through, in and out.
That is why a purr never stops for breath.
sentences.translationRu: Поэтому мурлыканье не прерывается на вдох.

sentences.text: A dog cannot do this.
Now, why do they do it?
One idea is very simple.
A kitten purrs when it is two days old.
sentences.translationRu: Котёнок мурлычет уже в два дня.

sentences.text: It is blind. It cannot walk.
The mother cannot see it in the dark.
sentences.translationRu: Мать не видит его в темноте.

sentences.text: But she can feel it.
The purr says: I am here, I am alive.
sentences.translationRu: Мурлыканье говорит: я здесь, я жив.

sentences.text: The mother purrs back.
It is the first conversation.
There is a second idea.
The sound is a low shaking.
Some scientists think it helps the body.
sentences.translationRu: Некоторые учёные думают, что она помогает телу.

sentences.text: Shaking at these speeds
can help bones grow stronger.
Cats sleep sixteen hours a day.
sentences.translationRu: Кошки спят по шестнадцать часов в день.

sentences.text: A body that never moves gets weak.
So maybe the purr is a small repair.
sentences.translationRu: Может быть, мурлыканье — это маленький ремонт.

sentences.text: This is still only an idea.
Nobody has proved it.
But it explains the cat at the doctor.
sentences.translationRu: Зато она объясняет кошку у врача.

sentences.text: It is not saying that everything is fine.
sentences.translationRu: Она не говорит, что всё хорошо.

sentences.text: It is asking for help, or making itself better.
sentences.translationRu: Она просит помощи или чинит себя.

title: Fog is a cloud that could not get up

sentences.text: You walk outside and the street is gone.
sentences.translationRu: Выходишь на улицу — а улицы нет.

sentences.text: You can see ten metres.
Sound is strange. Everything is soft.
This is fog.
And fog is not smoke.
It is not steam either.
It is a cloud that never left the ground.
sentences.translationRu: Это облако, которое не оторвалось от земли.

sentences.text: Exactly the same thing, in the same way.
sentences.translationRu: Ровно то же самое и устроено так же.

sentences.text: Air always has water in it.
You cannot see it, because it is a gas.
sentences.translationRu: Её не видно, потому что это газ.

sentences.text: Warm air can hold a lot of it.
Cold air can hold much less.
So cool the air down.
At some point it is holding too much.
sentences.translationRu: В какой-то момент воды в нём слишком много.

sentences.text: The extra water has to go somewhere.
It becomes very small drops.
Millions of them, in the air.
Small enough to float.
Light cannot go straight through them.
sentences.translationRu: Свет не проходит сквозь них прямо.

sentences.text: It bounces from drop to drop.
sentences.translationRu: Он скачет от капли к капле.

sentences.text: That is why fog is white.
And that is why you cannot see far.
Each drop needs something to start on.
sentences.translationRu: Каждой капле нужно, с чего начаться.

sentences.text: A speck of dust. Salt from the sea.
Perfectly clean air makes no fog at all.
sentences.translationRu: В идеально чистом воздухе тумана не будет.

sentences.text: There are different ways to cool the air.
On a clear night the ground loses heat.
The air above it gets cold.
By morning there is fog in the valley.
sentences.translationRu: К утру в низине стоит туман.

sentences.text: The sun comes up and it is gone by ten.
sentences.translationRu: Встаёт солнце — и к десяти его нет.

sentences.text: At sea it works the other way.
Warm air moves over cold water.
sentences.translationRu: Тёплый воздух идёт над холодной водой.

sentences.text: The water cools it from below.
That fog can last for days.
Some places live inside it.
One coast in South America has almost no rain.
sentences.translationRu: На одном побережье Южной Америки почти не бывает дождя.

sentences.text: But it has fog most mornings.
People there put up large nets.
Drops collect on the net.
They run down into a pipe.
One net can give many litres a day.
sentences.translationRu: Одна сетка даёт много литров в день.

sentences.text: They are catching a cloud with a fence.

title: Why your own voice sounds wrong on a recording

sentences.text: Almost everyone has had this moment.
sentences.translationRu: Почти у каждого был такой момент.

sentences.text: You hear yourself on a recording.
And something is badly wrong.
The voice is higher than it should be.
Thinner. Younger. A bit weak.
Not the voice you have been using all day.
sentences.translationRu: Не тот голос, которым ты говорил весь день.

sentences.text: The first reaction is usually the same.
sentences.translationRu: Первая реакция обычно одна и та же.

sentences.text: That is not how I sound.
The unwelcome news is that it is.
Everyone else has only ever heard that voice.
sentences.translationRu: Все остальные всегда слышали только этот голос.

sentences.text: The recording is the accurate one.
The one in your head is the strange version.
sentences.translationRu: Странная версия — та, что в голове.

sentences.text: The reason is that you hear yourself twice.
sentences.translationRu: Причина в том, что себя ты слышишь дважды.

sentences.text: Once through the air, like everybody else.
sentences.translationRu: Один раз через воздух, как все.

sentences.text: Sound leaves your mouth and comes back to your ears.
sentences.translationRu: Звук выходит изо рта и возвращается в уши.

sentences.text: And once through your own head.
sentences.translationRu: И один раз через собственную голову.

sentences.text: Your vocal cords shake the bone directly.
Jaw, skull, the small bones of the ear.
That path skips the air completely.
And bone is not a neutral material.
It carries low sounds very well.
sentences.translationRu: Низкие звуки она несёт очень хорошо.

sentences.text: It carries high ones poorly.
So the version inside your head
sentences.translationRu: Поэтому версия у тебя в голове

sentences.text: has extra bass that nobody else receives.
sentences.translationRu: имеет лишние басы, которых больше никто не получает.

sentences.text: Take that away and the voice thins out.
Which is exactly what a recording does.
This also explains something else.
Block your ears and speak.
You get louder without meaning to.
sentences.translationRu: Ты станешь громче, сам того не желая.

sentences.text: You have cut the air path.
So you compensate through the bone.
Singers know this problem well.
It is why they wear one earpiece.
And often pull it half out.
One ear for the real room.
One for the version everyone else hears.
sentences.translationRu: Другое — для версии, которую слышат все.

sentences.text: There is a small psychological tail to this.
sentences.translationRu: У этого есть небольшой психологический хвост.

sentences.text: People rate their recorded voice lower.
sentences.translationRu: Свой записанный голос люди оценивают ниже.

sentences.text: Others rate the same recording normally.
sentences.translationRu: Другие оценивают ту же запись нормально.

sentences.text: The discomfort is not about quality.
It is about expectation being broken.
Hear it enough times and it stops being odd.
sentences.translationRu: Послушай достаточно раз — и странность уходит.

sentences.text: Which is the only known cure.

title: The ingredient that was blamed for forty years

sentences.text: There are five basic tastes, not four.
sentences.translationRu: Основных вкусов пять, а не четыре.

sentences.text: Sweet, sour, salt, bitter — and one more.
sentences.translationRu: Сладкий, кислый, солёный, горький — и ещё один.

sentences.text: The fifth was named in Japan in 1908.
sentences.translationRu: Пятый назвали в Японии в 1908 году.

sentences.text: A chemist was working on seaweed stock.
sentences.translationRu: Химик работал с бульоном из водорослей.

sentences.text: He wanted to know why it tasted of more
sentences.translationRu: Он хотел понять, почему вкуса в нём больше,

sentences.text: than the things that went into it.
sentences.translationRu: чем в том, что туда положили.

sentences.text: He isolated the compound responsible.
sentences.translationRu: Он выделил отвечающее за это вещество.

sentences.text: It was a common amino acid.
The same one in tomatoes, cheese and meat.
sentences.translationRu: Та же, что в помидорах, сыре и мясе.

sentences.text: In anything cooked slowly or aged.
sentences.translationRu: В любом медленно готовленном или выдержанном продукте.

sentences.text: He called the taste umami.
And he made a salt of it, to sell.
sentences.translationRu: И сделал из него соль, чтобы продавать.

sentences.text: For sixty years it was uncontroversial.
Then, in 1968, a letter appeared.
sentences.translationRu: А потом, в 1968 году, вышло письмо.

sentences.text: It was published in a medical journal.
A doctor described feeling unwell
after eating at Chinese restaurants.
He listed several possible causes.
One of them was that seasoning.
sentences.translationRu: Одной из них была та самая приправа.

sentences.text: The letter was short and speculative.
What followed was neither.
sentences.translationRu: То, что последовало, не было ни тем ни другим.

sentences.text: The idea spread across newspapers.
It was given a name with a country in it.
sentences.translationRu: Ей дали название со страной внутри.

sentences.text: Restaurants put signs in their windows.
Not used here, the signs said.
Meanwhile the research went the other way.
sentences.translationRu: А исследования тем временем шли в другую сторону.

sentences.text: Dozens of trials were run over decades.
Give people the compound without telling them.
sentences.translationRu: Дай людям вещество, не сказав им.

sentences.text: Give others a placebo.
Neither group could tell the difference.
sentences.translationRu: Ни одна группа не смогла различить.

sentences.text: The effect appeared only when people knew.
sentences.translationRu: Эффект появлялся только когда люди знали.

sentences.text: Which is the signature of expectation.
Major food agencies reviewed it repeatedly.
sentences.translationRu: Крупные пищевые агентства пересматривали вопрос не раз.

sentences.text: They found no basis for the alarm.
The awkward part is what the panic selected.
sentences.translationRu: Неудобная часть — в том, что именно паника выбрала.

sentences.text: The same compound occurs naturally
in parmesan, in soy sauce, in tomatoes.
sentences.translationRu: в пармезане, в соевом соусе, в помидорах.

sentences.text: Nobody put a sign about parmesan in a window.
sentences.translationRu: Табличку про пармезан в окно никто не вешал.

sentences.text: The warnings attached to one cuisine.
And stayed there for forty years.
sentences.translationRu: И остались там на сорок лет.

sentences.text: It is now slowly being undone.
Chefs use the word umami freely.
The signs are coming out of the windows.
A correction that took two generations.
sentences.translationRu: Поправка, на которую ушло два поколения.

title: Blushing is the only expression nobody can fake

sentences.text: Every other human signal can be produced on demand.
sentences.translationRu: Любой другой человеческий сигнал можно выдать по заказу.

sentences.text: A smile can be manufactured.
Tears can be summoned by an actor.
A voice can be steadied deliberately.
Blushing cannot be done on purpose.
And, more importantly, it cannot be stopped.
Trying to suppress it reliably makes it worse.
Darwin called it the most peculiar
and the most human of all expressions.
sentences.translationRu: и самым человеческим из всех выражений.

sentences.text: He could not explain what it was for.
sentences.translationRu: И не смог объяснить, зачем оно.

sentences.text: The mechanism is understood well enough.
Small vessels in the face open.
Blood arrives close to the surface.
This is run by nerves you do not command.
sentences.translationRu: Этим управляют нервы, которые тебе не подчиняются.

sentences.text: The same system that handles a racing heart.
sentences.translationRu: Та же система, что отвечает за колотящееся сердце.

sentences.text: Which is why the will has no access to it.
sentences.translationRu: Поэтому воля до него не дотягивается.

sentences.text: The interesting question is the function.
Because on the surface it looks like a defect.
sentences.translationRu: Потому что внешне это выглядит как дефект.

sentences.text: You have done something socially awkward.
Your body's response is to advertise it.
sentences.translationRu: И тело в ответ это рекламирует.

sentences.text: In a colour visible across a room.
sentences.translationRu: Цветом, который виден через всю комнату.

sentences.text: No other animal appears to do this.
sentences.translationRu: Ни одно другое животное так, по-видимому, не делает.

sentences.text: The leading account inverts the problem.
A blush is not a leak.
It is a message, and an expensive one.
It says: I know I broke the rule.
sentences.translationRu: Оно говорит: я знаю, что нарушил правило.

sentences.text: I am not indifferent to your judgement.
sentences.translationRu: Мне не всё равно, что ты подумаешь.

sentences.text: And crucially: I could not have faked this.
sentences.translationRu: И главное: подделать это я не мог.

sentences.text: A signal that can be faked is cheap.
A signal outside voluntary control is not.
Which makes it worth believing.
Experiments support this fairly directly.
Show people someone who broke a small rule.
sentences.translationRu: Покажи людям того, кто нарушил мелкое правило.

sentences.text: Those who blush are judged more trustworthy.
sentences.translationRu: Покрасневших оценивают как более заслуживающих доверия.

sentences.text: They are forgiven faster.
They are punished less.
The blush is doing social work.
It repairs a relationship without a sentence.
sentences.translationRu: Оно чинит отношения без единой фразы.

sentences.text: There is a cruelty in the arrangement.
People who blush easily find it humiliating.
sentences.translationRu: Тем, кто легко краснеет, это унизительно.

sentences.text: Some avoid situations entirely because of it.
sentences.translationRu: Некоторые из-за этого вовсе избегают ситуаций.

sentences.text: A few have had nerves surgically cut.
To remove a signal that was working for them.
sentences.translationRu: Чтобы убрать сигнал, который работал в их пользу.

sentences.text: Which is worth sitting with for a moment.
sentences.translationRu: Об этом стоит на секунду задуматься.

sentences.text: The most honest thing your body does
sentences.translationRu: Самое честное, что делает твоё тело,

sentences.text: is the thing people most want removed.
sentences.translationRu: — это то, что люди сильнее всего хотят удалить.

title: A whale has a thousand times more cells than you

sentences.text: Cancer begins with one cell copying itself wrong.
sentences.translationRu: Рак начинается с одной клетки, скопировавшейся неверно.

sentences.text: Every division carries a small chance of error.
sentences.translationRu: Каждое деление несёт небольшой шанс ошибки.

sentences.text: So the arithmetic seems obvious.
More cells should mean more cancer.
A longer life should mean more again.
A blue whale has around a thousand times
sentences.translationRu: У синего кита примерно в тысячу раз

sentences.text: more cells than a person does.
And it lives roughly as long.
sentences.translationRu: И живёт он примерно столько же.

sentences.text: By that arithmetic it should be impossible.
Every whale should die young, of cancer.
sentences.translationRu: Каждый кит должен умирать молодым от рака.

sentences.text: They do not.
Large animals get less cancer, not more.
sentences.translationRu: Крупные животные болеют раком реже, а не чаще.

sentences.text: This is called Peto's paradox.
And it has turned out to be useful.
Because it means the defences exist.
sentences.translationRu: Потому что он означает, что защиты существуют.

sentences.text: Somewhere in nature, they are already built.
sentences.translationRu: Где-то в природе они уже построены.

sentences.text: Elephants gave the first clear answer.
Humans carry one copy of a particular gene
sentences.translationRu: У человека одна копия определённого гена

sentences.text: that tells a damaged cell to stop.
Or to destroy itself, if the damage is bad.
sentences.translationRu: Или уничтожить себя, если повреждение серьёзное.

sentences.text: Elephants carry around twenty copies.
sentences.translationRu: У слонов таких копий около двадцати.

sentences.text: Their cells are ruthless about it.
Damage that a human cell might repair
sentences.translationRu: Повреждение, которое человеческая клетка починила бы,

sentences.text: an elephant cell answers by dying.
Losing a cell is cheap when you have so many.
sentences.translationRu: Терять клетку дёшево, когда их так много.

sentences.text: Whales appear to have gone another way.
Their rate of mutation looks lower.
Their repair systems look more careful.
Fewer errors rather than harsher punishment.
sentences.translationRu: Меньше ошибок вместо более сурового наказания.

sentences.text: Small long-lived animals solve it differently again.
sentences.translationRu: Мелкие долгоживущие животные решают это ещё иначе.

sentences.text: One burrowing rodent produces a substance
that stops cells crowding together at all.
sentences.translationRu: которое вообще не даёт клеткам скучиваться.

sentences.text: A tumour needs crowding to become a tumour.
sentences.translationRu: А опухоли для того, чтобы стать опухолью, скучивание нужно.

sentences.text: So at least three different solutions exist.
sentences.translationRu: То есть существует минимум три разных решения.

sentences.text: Evolution found each of them separately.
Which tells you the problem is solvable
in more than one direction.
None of this transfers to medicine directly.
sentences.translationRu: Ничего из этого не переносится в медицину напрямую.

sentences.text: Extra copies of that gene are not a treatment.
sentences.translationRu: Лишние копии того гена — не лечение.

sentences.text: A cell too eager to destroy itself
causes its own kind of damage.
But it reframes the question usefully.
The old question was how to stop cancer.
sentences.translationRu: Старый вопрос был: как остановить рак.

sentences.text: The better one is how the whale already did.
sentences.translationRu: Лучший: как это уже сделал кит.
